name: 1035-rerank-qwen2-7b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen2-7B-Instruct. Ungated; ~15.2 GiB of weights, fetched to the local HF cache during the build.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One GPU, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen2ForCausalLM, 28 layers, 28 query heads and 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, hidden 3584, intermediate 18944, vocab 152064, bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 640 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, against `/v1/completions`. Every request is a 1024-token preamble drawn from a pool of 8 distinct ones, prepended to a unique candidate passage of ~1024 tokens (stdev 128, clamped 512-1536), generating exactly ONE token, with `logprobs: 1` on every request (carried in scenario.json under `spec.backend.extras.body`). Total input ~2048 tokens. Seed 42.
purpose: A passage reranking service scoring candidates against eight shared instruction preambles, eight concurrent streams, one GPU.
launch:
# sglang 0.2.13 server arguments. Flat `key: value` only -- the reader takes this file line by
# line and skips indented ones, so a nested block silently drops the key it declares.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2-7B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# The longest request this workload can draw is 2561 tokens; the checkpoint's own 32768 would
# size several buffers for a context this workload never reaches.
context-length: 4096

# Memory bounds for this model on an 80 GB card, not tuning knobs.
mem-fraction-static: 0.70
max-prefill-tokens: 2048

random-seed: 42
